scripts.dev: concurrently "cd apps/api && npm run dev" "cd apps/web && npm run dev"
scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.start: concurrently "cd apps/api && npm run start" "cd apps/web && npm run start"
scripts.lint: npm run lint:web && npm run lint:api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:web && npm run typecheck:api
